hints.title: Two-Dimensional Frequency Pivot Table
hints.text: Group food order quantities by table number and food item name into a two-dimensional count matrix.

hints.title: Sorted Row and Column Header Ordering
hints.text: Sort table numbers numerically as row keys, and sort distinct food items alphabetically as header columns.

hints.title: Output Matrix Formatting Blueprint
hints.text: Format header row as Table followed by sorted food names. For each sorted table number, emit table string followed by string count for each food item.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def displayTable(self, orders: list[list[str]]) -> list[list[str]]:
        foods = set()
        tables = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))

        for _, tbl, food in orders:
            foods.add(food)
            tables[int(tbl)][food] += 1

        sorted_foods = sorted(foods)
        res = [["Table"] + sorted_foods]

        for tbl in sorted(tables.keys()):
            row = [str(tbl)]
            for f in sorted_foods:
                row.append(str(tables[tbl][f]))
            res.append(row)
        return res
```

complexity.time: O(N + T * log T + F * log F + T * F)
variables: F: number of distinct food items
complexity.notes: Constructs the pivot matrix in time proportional to total orders plus output dimensions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-filtering the raw order list for every (table, food) cell creates an O(N * T * F) cubic workload.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Nested dictionary grouping caches frequencies for direct O(1) table row emission.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct numerical sorting of table rows and alphabetical sorting of food columns.
